name: LTX 2.3 IC-LoRA — reference sheet to video (ingredients + audio)
title: Turn a reference sheet into video
summary: Upload one sheet showing your character, a prop and a place as panels tiled edge to edge (no wide black margins, no text), then describe a scene; the video keeps all three looking just like the sheet, with sound. Pick it to keep a character consistent from shot to shot.
description:
Generate a new video whose characters, props and location match a reference sheet, made by hand or with the "Place characters with boxes" card (MOSS base), as in this card's example. A page from Dynamic Charactersheet krea2 is only a starting point: remove its titles and labels (the sheet must carry no text) and add a panel of the location, which it does not draw.

Upload ONE composite image with no text, a clean panel for each element — a face close-up and full-body turnaround for each character, a product-style view of each prop, and one wide shot of the location — and the panels TILED EDGE TO EDGE so they fill the sheet, separated by thin black lines (like ComfyUI's own example sheet). Then describe what happens. LTX 2.3 with the Ingredients IC-LoRA keeps those elements consistent through the clip and generates matching audio (dialogue written in quotes is spoken).

Write the prompt in two parts, the way the model was trained: first describe the panels on the sheet ("Reference sheet: …"), then the shot, action and sound ("Generated video: …"). Bigger panels carry over better, and anything that isn't on the sheet won't stay consistent.

Duration must be at least 5 seconds (the model needs 121+ frames). The model was trained at 768×448; the default size looks sharper but takes longer (1280×720 asked; LTX rounds the height down to a multiple of 32, so the video comes out 1280×704), and the sheet is letterboxed with black to fit. "Reference strength" controls how strongly the sheet is followed; it starts at 1.4, the model card's own setting. ★ The layout of the sheet matters more than any setting. Measured on this machine: a sheet of small panels floating in wide black margins came back as ITSELF — the panels laid out on black with invented lettering — at strength 1.0, 1.4 and 1.8, and even on the full LTX 2.3 dev model; the same card with ComfyUI's example sheet, and with the same clockmaker redrawn edge to edge, filmed the scene. A sheet can still show through (a small copy of a panel in the room), so try another seed if one does.

promptGuides.label: LTX-2.3 prompt guide — Lightricks blog
promptGuides.tip: Longer, detailed prompts beat short ones: describe the action and camera over time in one present-tense paragraph, and match the prompt length to the clip length.

### Reference Sheet Description **Top Row Left (Character):** An anthropomorphic bipedal German Shepherd news anchor with realistic brown, tan, and black fur, a calm professional expression, and thin round copper-bronze framed glasses. He is shown in close-up portraits and full-body front, three-quarter, side, and back views standing upright like a person, with a humanoid torso and limbs and a long bushy German Shepherd tail. He wears a vibrant long-sleeve button-down shirt with an abstract multicolored pink-purple-turquoise-yellow woven pattern, dark charcoal dress pants, and dark leather dress shoes. **Top Row Right (Prop):** A professional black studio condenser microphone on a short circular desk stand shown from multiple angles, plus black over-the-ear wireless earpieces / headsets for broadcast cues. **Middle Row Right (Prop):** A flat product view of the same vibrant long-sleeve multicolored patterned button-down shirt, clearly showing the abstract pink, purple, turquoise, and yellow woven texture. **Bottom Row (Setting):** A wide shot of a high-end professional news studio with a large curved dark teal anchor desk in the foreground, a massive digital backdrop screen displaying bold white "NEWS" lettering over soft blue-green abstract graphics, and polished cinematic broadcast lighting with studio fixtures visible around the set.

### Target Description A cozy, cinematic scene inside a high-end professional news studio. The camera begins on a wide establishing shot of the large curved dark teal anchor desk and the soft-focus blue-green "NEWS" backdrop, then smoothly pushes in to a steady medium shot of the anthropomorphic bipedal German Shepherd news anchor seated behind the desk. He has realistic brown-tan-black fur, thin round copper-bronze glasses, and a calm professional expression. He wears the vibrant long-sleeve multicolored pink-purple-turquoise-yellow patterned button-down shirt with dark charcoal dress pants. His paw-like hands rest on the desk near the black studio condenser microphone. The studio is bathed in polished cinematic broadcast light from the backdrop and overhead fixtures. His initial expression is focused and composed, then he leans slightly toward the microphone, softens into a confident on-air smile, and speaks clearly to camera: "Good evening, and welcome to tonight's top stories." He pauses briefly, glances down at the desk, then looks back up and continues: "Here's what you need to know." The background "NEWS" screen and studio lights remain softly detailed behind him, emphasizing his face, glasses, and colorful shirt under the clean broadcast lighting.
